user.title: Connect to Stockroom
user.description: Enter the address of your Stockroom instance and an API token. The token is validated against your Stockroom account.

data_description.host: The base address of your Stockroom instance, including host and port.
data_description.token: A Stockroom API token with at least the read ability (write is needed for linking).
data_description.name: Name shown in Home Assistant (default: Stockroom)

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Stockroom
reauth_confirm.description: The API token for {host} is no longer valid. Enter a new token.

abort.already_configured: This Stockroom instance is already configured.

init.title: Stockroom
init.description: Link Home Assistant devices to Stockroom items, or change settings.

menu_options.link_device: Link a device to an existing Stockroom item
menu_options.create_and_link: Create a Stockroom item from a device and link it
menu_options.bulk_create_from_area: Bulk create Stockroom items from an area
menu_options.link_area: Link a Home Assistant area to a Stockroom room

data_description.scan_interval_minutes: How often (in minutes) to poll Stockroom for statistics and linked-item updates.

link_device.title: Select a device
link_device.description: Choose the Home Assistant device to link to a Stockroom item.

link_method.title: Find the Stockroom item
link_method.description: Choose how to find the Stockroom item to link to {device_name}.

link_search.title: Search Stockroom
link_search.description: Search for the item to link to {device_name}.

link_search_results.title: Select a match
link_search_results.description: Choose the Stockroom item to link to {device_name}.

link_browse.title: Select a room
link_browse.description: Choose the room to browse for an unlinked item.

link_browse_items.title: Select an item
link_browse_items.description: Choose an unlinked Stockroom item from this room.

link_enter_id.title: Enter item ID
link_enter_id.description: Enter the Stockroom item ID to link to {device_name}.

link_confirm.title: Item already linked elsewhere
link_confirm.description: Stockroom item #{item_id} is already linked to another Home Assistant instance ({friendly_name}). Replace that link with {device_name}?

create_and_link.title: Select a device
create_and_link.description: Choose the Home Assistant device to create a new Stockroom item for.

create_item_details.title: New Stockroom item
create_item_details.description: Create and link a Stockroom item for {device_name}. Details are pre-filled from Home Assistant where available.

data_description.serial_number: Pre-filled from the device's serial number when Home Assistant knows it.

unlink_device.title: Unlink a device
unlink_device.description: Choose the linked device to unlink from its Stockroom item.

bulk_create_from_area.title: Select an area
bulk_create_from_area.description: Choose a Home Assistant area to create Stockroom items for its devices.

bulk_select_devices.title: Select devices
bulk_select_devices.description: Choose the unlinked devices in {area_name} to create Stockroom items for.

bulk_create_details.title: Create items
bulk_create_details.description: A Stockroom item will be created and linked for each of the {count} selected device(s).

link_area.title: Link an area to a room
link_area.description: Map a Home Assistant area to a Stockroom room. New items created from devices in that area are then placed in the mapped room by default. Leave the room blank to remove a mapping.

error.device_already_linked: That device is already linked to a Stockroom item.
error.device_has_no_entity: That device has no entities, so it cannot be linked.
error.link_conflict: Cannot create the link: the device or item is already linked.
error.token_read_only: This needs a Stockroom token with the write ability, but the configured token is read-only.
error.create_failed: Failed to create the Stockroom item. Check the details and try again.
error.no_devices_selected: Select at least one device to continue.
error.no_results: No matching Stockroom items were found. Try a different search.
error.not_linked: That device is no longer linked.

abort.no_unlinked_items: No unlinked Stockroom items are available.
abort.no_unlinked_ha_devices: No unlinked devices are available in that area.
abort.item_not_found: That Stockroom item was not found.
abort.link_conflict: That device or item is already linked.
abort.token_read_only: This needs a Stockroom token with the write ability, but the configured token is read-only.
abort.link_not_replaced: The existing link was kept; no changes were made.

link_item.name: Link item
link_item.description: Links a Home Assistant device to an existing Stockroom item and writes a deep link back into Stockroom.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Any entity whose device should be linked. The device is resolved from this entity.

item_id.name: Stockroom item ID
item_id.description: Numeric ID of the Stockroom item to link to.

friendly_name.name: Friendly name
friendly_name.description: Optional name to store on the Stockroom link. Defaults to the device name.

unlink_item.name: Unlink item
unlink_item.description: Removes the link between a Home Assistant device and its Stockroom item.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Any entity whose device is currently linked.

create_and_link_item.name: Create and link item
create_and_link_item.description: Creates a new Stockroom item for an unmatched Home Assistant device and links it.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Any entity whose device should get a new Stockroom item.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name for the new Stockroom item. Defaults to the device name.

parent_id.name: Parent ID
parent_id.description: Optional Stockroom parent (room or container) ID.

search.name: Search
search.description: Searches Stockroom for items and returns the top hits with their location path.

query.name: Query
query.description: Text to search for (for example, "where is the drill?").

integration_not_loaded.message: The Stockroom integration is not loaded.

entity_not_found.message: Entity {entity_id} was not found in the entity registry.

entity_has_no_device.message: Entity {entity_id} is not attached to a device.

token_read_only.message: This action needs a Stockroom token with the write ability, but the configured token is read-only.

invalid_token.message: The configured Stockroom token is invalid. Re-authenticate the integration.
